name: Hudu Shiv's Pursuer-class enforcement ship
description: A Pursuer-class enforcement ship belonged to the Mandalorian Death Watch member Hudu Shiv. He used the vessel during an assassination in 22 BBY. Shiv used the vessel as a decoy and it was destroyed by the transport Hasty Harpy; this successfully fooled the Jedi Padawan Nuru Kungurama into thinking Shiv was dead.
